title: UI issue/regression with "reconnecting" a tab
author: MelanieTanaka
body_snippet:
Hello,

Just had to upgrade from stable (1.77.1) to nightly (1.78.2 NB 3405) to solve a crashing issue after some windows updates.

On 1.78.2 NB 3405 I am now experiencing a regression in UI behavior:
I have multiple tabs opened in a specific order required for my workflow
I sometimes have to right click -> reconnect a tab
When I do that, the tab moves out of its place and to the front of the list of tabs.

In 1.77.1 this did not happen, the tab stayed where it was.
